title: Kodak Invented the Digital Camera, Then Shelved It
description:
In 1975 a Kodak engineer built the first digital camera. Kodak did not push it, to protect its film business. In 2012 the company filed for bankruptcy. The full story of Fuji, the patents, and one hard lesson about protecting today's profit.

Dramatised: scenes are illustrations; the facts come from the sources below. Kodak's internal reaction is as reported by the sources.
